perf.summary: Hoist primes[j] and replace the i%primes[j] division with the smallest-prime-factor equality test, mirroring the min-prime sieve.
perf.currentCost: Inner loop reloads primes[j] up to 3 times and performs i%primes[j] every iteration (~n total divisions).
perf.proposedChange: long pj = primes[j] cached; and track minPrime separately or note that the break occurs exactly when pj is the smallest prime factor of i. If a min-prime array isn't maintained here, at minimum cache pj to remove redundant loads. Optionally fuse with the min-prime variant to share the spf to drop the division.
perf.rationale: Eliminates redundant loads and (if spf tracked) a division per inner iteration in the hot loop.
perf.risk: The division-elimination requires tracking spf which adds an int* array; if not maintained, only the load-CSE part applies (zero risk). The pj caching is unconditionally safe.
